title: 用Seedance 2.0 Mini模型生成视频里的空镜（B-roll/establishing shots），比在素材库里找现成片段更省事
content:
用Seedance 2.0 Mini模型生成视频里的空镜（B-roll/establishing shots），比在素材库里找现成片段更省事  
生成空镜时可直接让Seedance同步生成配套声音（音画同步输出）
tips:

en.content:
Using the Seedance 2.0 Mini model to generate B-roll / establishing shots for videos is more convenient than searching for ready-made clips in stock footage libraries.  
When generating B-roll, you can have Seedance generate matching audio at the same time, with synchronized audio and video output.
